import java.util.Scanner;

public class GeneticEngineering {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scn = new Scanner(System.in);
        String str = scn.nextLine();
        if (str.isEmpty()) {
            System.out.println(0);
            return;
        }
        System.out.println(countEvenRuns(str, 1, 0));
    }

    private static int countEvenRuns(String s, int i, int start) {
        if (i == s.length()) {
            return ((i - start) % 2 == 0) ? 1 : 0;
        }
        if (s.charAt(i) != s.charAt(start)) {
            int add = ((i - start) % 2 == 0) ? 1 : 0;
            return add + countEvenRuns(s, i, i);
        }
        return countEvenRuns(s, i + 1, start);
    }
}

import java.util.Scanner;
import java.util.stream.IntStream;

public class GeneticEngineering {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scn = new Scanner(System.in);
        String str = scn.nextLine();
        if (str.isEmpty()) {
            System.out.println(0);
            return;
        }
        int[] starts = IntStream.concat(
            IntStream.of(0),
            IntStream.range(1, str.length()).filter(i -> str.charAt(i) != str.charAt(i - 1))
        ).toArray();
        int os = IntStream.range(0, starts.length)
            .map(i -> {
                int end = (i + 1 < starts.length) ? starts[i + 1] : str.length();
                return ((end - starts[i]) % 2 == 0) ? 1 : 0;
            })
            .sum();
        System.out.println(os);
    }
}
